name: SaykoAI Companion
author: Hamid Safari

sections.description:
SaykoAI Companion is a WordPress plugin that provides an advanced template system, custom post types (like saykoai_chat and saykoai_template), real-time AJAX chat management, and integration with AI prompts and models. Ideal for AI chat sites, prompt-to-text workflows, and dynamic layouts with the SaykoAI theme.

Key features:
– Custom post types for chats and templates
– Secure AJAX handlers for chat creation, messaging, and management
– Template post type and drivers that load header, footer, sidebar, layout, and single templates stored as Gutenberg content
– The SaykoAI theme places those templates in the matching theme locations
– Meta fields and Customizer integration for layout customization
– Private per-user chat visibility and history persistence
– Optional starter sites catalog from saykoai.site, loaded only after admin consent. Demo plugins are installed from WordPress.org.

External services

This plugin can connect to the SaykoAI starter sites service at saykoai.site. That service is used only to list available demo sites and to download a demo package after an administrator explicitly agrees.

No remote request is made until an administrator checks the consent box and clicks “Load starter sites”. After that, the plugin may send the requested demo slug and, if a license key is saved, that key in an X-SaykoAI-License-Key header so pro demos can be unlocked. Importing a demo also downloads the demo content and its media files from that host. Visitor data is not sent. Required plugins are installed from WordPress.org, not from saykoai.site.

This service is provided by SaykoAI: terms of use, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the saykoai-companion folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Add your OpenAI API key under Settings → Connectors
  4. Open SaykoAI Companion in the dashboard to manage templates and starter sites. Model and layout options are in Appearance → Customize.
sections.faq:
How do I configure AI API keys?

Add your OpenAI API key under Settings → Connectors. Model and personality options stay in Appearance → Customize. If you use a custom AI endpoint, its key is set in Appearance → Customize → Custom AI API.

Are chats private?

Yes, chats are tied to the logged-in user and only visible to the owner (admins can edit).

Does it work with any theme?

No. SaykoAI Companion is built for the SaykoAI theme and adds its enhancements only when that theme is installed and active.

Where is the source code?

Unminified admin JavaScript and CSS live in resources/admin/ inside this plugin. The compiled files in assets/admin/ are built with Vite (npm run build).

How do starter sites work?

Opening Starter Sites does not contact a remote server until you agree to load the catalog from saykoai.site. Importing a demo downloads content from that service. Required plugins are installed from WordPress.org only.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial stable release
  • Custom post types: saykoai_chat and saykoai_template
  • AJAX handlers for chat creation, messaging, deletion, and stats
  • Template loader with fallback single template
  • Secure nonce verification and input sanitization
  • Driver system for headers, footers, sidebars, and layouts
